errors.evidence: The prompt asks for the total number of slices, but the description omits this information. The chart shows 26 slices.
The description lists a category "ADE" with a value of 1%, which does not exist in the pie chart.
The description omits two categories that are present in the chart, both with 1%: "Specific Disease" and "Chemical Entity".
The prompt asks to describe the color of each slice, but the description only makes a general statement that the chart uses distinct colors without specifying any.
The prompt asks to note if the slices appear ordered. The slices are clearly ordered by descending size, but the description fails to mention this.
